description: The fuel in the tanks at each point of the route and whether it is under the reserve of the flight it is on (each flight's own: 30 minutes by day, 14 CFR 91.151(a)(1); 45 at night, 91.151(a)(2), or under IFR, 91.167(a)(3); by that flight's own times and rules): at the departure the fuel on board at engine start (full, the usable fuel, unless the pilot set their own; more than usable kept as set), the start, taxi and takeoff allowance and each leg's burn taken from them after; at each field landed at the fuel on landing, the tanks then fuelled for the next flight (full unless the pilot set what to; a figure under what is left keeps it, 0 no fuel bought) and its start and taxi taken again, as the planner checks each flight; the departure low where what is on board, less the start and taxi, is under its flight's reserve, and the destination held to the IFR alternate's fuel too (91.167(a)(2)); negative past empty, the gallons short; null at a point past a leg whose burn is not known, until the next fill, and at every point where no flight's reserve is given.

fuel_gal.description: The burn of the leg to it.

refuel.description: The tanks filled on landing there.

fill_gal.description: The pilot's own figure for the tanks as the airplane leaves there, gallons: at the departure the fuel on board at engine start, at a field landed at what it is fuelled to (under what is left keeps what is left; 0, no fuel bought); null, full.

reserves_gal.description: Each flight's own reserve, gallons, in order: the first the departure's flight, the next the one from the first field landed at (refuel), as the planner's totals give each flight's reserve_gal. A point is low against the reserve of the flight that lands at or passes it; a flight with none given (null, or past the list's end) is held to the strictest given; with none given at all, every point is null, not known.

alternate_gal.description: Under IFR with an alternate filed, the fuel on to it from the destination, gallons (14 CFR 91.167(a)(2)): the route's last point is held to its flight's reserve and this; null or 0 under VFR.

leaves_gal.description: Where the tanks are filled (the departure, a field landed at), what they hold as the airplane leaves: the pilot's own figure, full, or what it landed with where the figure is under that; null elsewhere.
